structure: A single 24-line Markdown ruling file (workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/ruling-sam-2026-11-10b.md) from Sam, dated 10 November 2026, the second ruling of that day. It runs: a heading (line 1); one framing sentence saying Sam decided on the review of the obligation model and test tidy-up rows, that the review is workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/stale-theme-review/findings.json, and that a second agent checked each verdict (lines 3-4); Sam's verbatim quote, two lines of lower-case blockquote holding three decisions in one breath - 'no, move them to the theme that does the work. yes drop obligation model row. the return links consider as blocked waiting on the save and continue theme which is currently being built on another machine.' (lines 6-7); then a '## Decided' heading (line 9) and the main session's reading as 3 numbered claims (lines 11-24). Claim 1 drops the obligation model row inc-245, with its reasoning (main already tells a hard stop from a submission check; each page refuses a missing required answer; the review refuses submission; both save buttons make the same checks, citing inc-232; the one all-or-nothing group in V4, accompanying documents, is refused when half-filled; the model has had allOrNothingOfIds and anyOfIds since September), what is lost (the manifest never names 'mandatory to proceed' as its own marking, and no single test proves the markings together), that req-2206 and req-2207 are out of scope, and that the obligation-model theme is removed (lines 11-16). Claim 2 moves the overview and review class-list checks to the theme that does the work: the hub's totals box, button and caption line-height checks to overview-and-review inc-098, the review's visually-hidden and summary-card class checks and the review's last-card screenshot to overview-and-review inc-101, with the live animals class-name row inc-234 keeping the rest and dropping the overview and transit countries screenshots as already on the tests repo's main (lines 17-21). Claim 3 blocks the return links row inc-235 until the save and continue work has merged, naming EUDPA-774, branch feat/EUDPA-774-save-and-continue-through-journey and workarea workareas/shared/eudpa-774, and takes its commodities half out of the row as already on main (lines 22-24). No claim is marked New or as replacing a conflict; the file carries no evidence table and no other quote. The review the ruling answers covers four rows (inc-245, inc-234, inc-235, inc-236) while the ruling and its claims name only the first three, so inc-236 is a point the file touches by reference and leaves open. Scope is the whole file, so nothing is left out. It is one part: 24 lines, well inside what one agent reads word for word.

parts.title: Whole ruling
parts.scope: The whole file: the heading and framing sentence (lines 1-4), Sam's single verbatim quote (lines 6-7) and the 3 numbered claims under '## Decided' (lines 11-24). There is no other part.
covers: The framing the file gives the ruling: Sam decided on the review of the obligation model and test tidy-up rows, the review being workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/stale-theme-review/findings.json, with each verdict checked by a second agent

Sam's quote, verbatim and in full, as the one source for every decision: 'no, move them to the theme that does the work. yes drop obligation model row. the return links consider as blocked waiting on the save and continue theme which is currently being built on another machine.' - three decisions in one quote, so each claim must be checked against its own clause

Claim 1, checked against 'yes drop obligation model row': the obligation model row inc-245 is dropped - what the quote says in so many words (the drop itself) against what it does not (the reasoning, the losses, the scope change and the theme removal, which are the main session's reading)

Claim 1's stated reasons, each recorded as the claim's supporting ground rather than as a decision of its own: main already tells a hard stop from a submission check; each page refuses a missing required answer itself; the review refuses submission; both save buttons make the same checks (citing inc-232); the one all-or-nothing group in V4, accompanying documents, is refused when half-filled; the model has had allOrNothingOfIds and anyOfIds since September
Claim 1's stated losses, recorded as what the drop accepts: the manifest never names 'mandatory to proceed' as its own marking, and no single test proves the markings together
Claim 1's scope consequences: req-2206 and req-2207 are out of scope, and the obligation-model theme is removed

Claim 2, checked against 'no, move them to the theme that does the work': the overview and review class-list checks move to the theme that does the work - the 'no' and the move are in the quote, the destination rows are not

Claim 2's three allocations, each named separately: the hub's totals box, button and caption line-height checks go to overview-and-review inc-098; the review's visually-hidden and summary-card class checks and the review's last-card screenshot go to overview-and-review inc-101; the live animals class-name row inc-234 keeps the rest
Claim 2's drop: inc-234 drops the overview and transit countries screenshots, with the stated reason that they are already on the tests repo's main

Claim 3, checked against 'the return links consider as blocked waiting on the save and continue theme which is currently being built on another machine': the return links row inc-235 is blocked until the save and continue work has merged - the block and its condition are in the quote, the identifiers are not

Claim 3's identifiers for the blocking work, recorded as the main session's reading: EUDPA-774, the branch feat/EUDPA-774-save-and-continue-through-journey, and the workarea workareas/shared/eudpa-774
Claim 3's removal: inc-235's commodities half comes out of the row, with the stated reason that it is already on main

Each claim marked verbatim only where Sam's quote says it in so many words, and inferred otherwise with the statement saying what in the quote implies it - the quote is two lines and names no increment, row, ticket, branch, requirement or theme, so every id (inc-245, inc-098, inc-101, inc-234, inc-235, inc-232, req-2206, req-2207, EUDPA-774) comes from the main session's reading, not from Sam

Every increment, requirement, ticket, branch, workarea and theme reference the claims cite, recorded in the claim's note: inc-245, inc-234, inc-235, inc-098, inc-101, inc-232, req-2206, req-2207, EUDPA-774, feat/EUDPA-774-save-and-continue-through-journey, workareas/shared/eudpa-774, the overview-and-review theme and the obligation-model theme

Gap claims, with an empty quote, for what the ruling touches and leaves open: the review it answers (stale-theme-review/findings.json) carries a fourth row, inc-236, that neither the quote nor any claim rules on; the quote's 'another machine' names no ticket, branch or workarea, so claim 3's identifiers rest on the main session's reading alone; the quote gives no date or condition for unblocking inc-235 beyond 'has merged', so nothing says who checks it or when; claim 1 removes a theme and puts two requirements out of scope without the quote naming either; and the ruling says nothing about the germinal-products set or the high-risk plants frontend, which the programme goal otherwise changes alongside live animals

That no claim in this file is marked New or as replacing an earlier conflict, so each must be matched to the report question or conflict it answers from the review it names, and recorded as unmatched where the file gives none
